mcpStudio.title: MCP server
mcpStudio.lede: Choose which of this server's tools agents can call, and how each one is described and shaped.

mcpStudio.truncated: The kill switch board holds more switches than one read returns, so a switch on this server may be missing here.

missing.title: Server not found
missing.body: This workspace holds no MCP server with that id. It may have been removed.

tools.title: Tools
tools.missing: Discovery has not listed this server's tools yet. The table shows the tools the registry holds.
tools.readOnly: Only an organization owner or admin can import tools or change their classification.
tools.refused: The draft cannot hold that edit, so it was not kept. Remove an edit on the Changes tab or discard the draft first.

empty.title: No tools
empty.body: The server listed no tools the last time Oxagen read it.

budget.missing: The definition budget is set in tools.toml, and Oxagen has not read this server's tools.toml yet.
budget.unmeasured: The budget is {budget} tokens. Some imported tools have no measured definition, so the total is not known.

basis.source_hint: From a hint in the source definition.

panel.importFirst: Import this tool before you change its classification or description.
panel.draftHint: Draft asks a model to write the description. Its cost is billed as in-app agent spend.
panel.draftNotBuilt: Draft is not available yet. You can write the description yourself.
panel.shapingMissing: Shaping is set in tools.toml, and Oxagen has not read this server's tools.toml yet.
panel.serverMissing: Oxagen has not recorded what the server says about this tool yet.
panel.feedbackMissing: Oxagen has not recorded how agents use this tool yet.

source.title: Source

environments.title: Environments
environments.agentsUnset: No environment is set for agents yet.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.note: A credential stays in the Oxagen vault. This page shows only its reference, and a steering PR never carries it.

machines.title: Machines
machines.body: The local gateway runs this server on enrolled machines. Oxagen sends it no credential.

try.title: Try a tool
try.live: This environment is not a sandbox. The call reaches the real service.
try.argsHint: A JSON object with the tool's arguments.
try.badJson: The arguments are not a JSON object.
try.credentialNote: The call is recorded and metered like an agent's. The gateway adds the credential after the request is recorded, so the request shown never holds it.
try.tooLarge: The draft is full, so the test was not saved.
try.badRecord: This call's record is not in the shape a saved test needs, so the test was not saved.
try.stripped: Removed the {headers} {count, plural, one {header} other {headers}} before saving, because a saved test never holds a credential.
try.notBuilt: Try it is not available yet.

empty.title: No imported tools
empty.body: Import a tool on the Tools tab to try it here.

empty.title: No changes
empty.body: Edits you make on the Tools tab and tests you save on Try it collect here.

ops.test: Add a test call to {tool} in {environment}

files.title: Files
files.folderMissing: Oxagen has not recorded this server's steering folder yet, so the paths are the defaults.

surface.title: Tool surface
surface.none: The tools agents see do not change.

findings.title: Findings
findings.missing: The tool checks have not run on this draft yet.

pr.title: Steering PR
pr.body: Open steering PR writes the draft to the server's steering folder as a pull request. A person merges it before agents see the change.
pr.readOnly: Only an organization owner or admin can open a steering PR.
pr.notBuilt: Opening a steering PR from Studio is not available yet.
pr.failed: The steering PR did not open: {message}
pr.conflict: Someone saved this server's draft after you last did. Your edits are now staged on top of theirs. Check the edits, then open the steering PR again.
pr.conflictDropped: {count, plural, one {# edit did not fit the saved draft and was left out.} other {# edits did not fit the saved draft and were left out.}}
pr.folderMissing: Oxagen has not recorded this server's steering folder yet, so a steering PR cannot be opened from here.
pr.sourceMissing: The steering PR needs the server's definition to go with this draft, and Oxagen has not recorded it yet.
